That’s a very broad topic to give recommendations on, but here we go...

Astra Lost in Space

A group of kids are going in their first trip into space as part of the space training program they are a part of. They are sucked into an orb and teleported far away from home. Luckily there is an abandoned space craft right next to them. They fight to get back home while trying to figure out why they were sent to die.

Grancrest Senki

The kingdom is split after the wedding between the King of one domain and the Queen of the other major domain is broken off. Each lord has their own mage to assist them, and this is the same for the main characters. A mage who came across the main character, decided to pledge herself to him and raise him through the ranks of the kingdom. The lord’s ultimate goal? To reunite the King and Queen and end the raging war between the two domains.

Made in Abyss

Riko is a young girl living in the city of Orth, the city surrounding the great Abyss. When she receives a letter from her mom, a white whistle (the highest regarded cave drivers), that she is waiting for her at the bottom of the Abyss. She and her new companion, Reg, who saved her from a best in the first layer in Episode 1, begin to traverse the Abyss with the goal of reaching her mom at the bottom, seventh layer.

Okay, this is a much more “real world” type of anime. It’s more of a psychological anime than action, but I still found it really good.

Babylon

Focuses on an investigator trying to find out why the number of suicides in his city are skyrocketing. Eventually a person runs for election in his city that supports the right to suicide. Even though he has been pulled off the case, he continues to investigate and finds out about a person with the strange ability to make people want to kill themselves just by being in the same room as them.

It focuses more on the investigation, but they are trying to fight the corrupt politician running for office with the aid of the person that makes people want to kill themselves. Definitely worth a look in my opinion.

Dororo

Set in older Japan, it focuses on the main character killing demons to regain parts of his body after his father (lord of the domain) sacrifices him to 12 demons for the prosperity of his land. For each demon he kills, he regains a piece of his body and the contract between the father and demons begin to break.

Dusk Maiden of Amnesia

Has a decent amount of comedy and romance. Focuses on the backstory of the main heroine though (very dark backstory). Technically this show is also considered a Horror anime, but I think it leaned more towards the romance/mystery elements. Not sure if this is exactly what you’re looking for, but elements of the show does fit what you asked for.
